aspect: The burden is to evidence intimacy
description: Photographs, messages, joint bills, and testimony about domestic detail. A couple who keep separate finances or are private by temperament produce a weaker file than a couple who are not.
energy_note: Assessed on how documentable your love is.

description: Two people asked which side of the bed the other sleeps on will sometimes disagree, because people are not databases. The discrepancy is recorded as evidence of a sham.
energy_note: Misremembering a detail, recorded as a lie.

description: 'Your wife says you met in March. You said February.' He lets that sit. 'One of you is lying to me. I don't mind which.' They met in late February and married in a March two years later, and he knows that, because he has both files in front of him.
energy_note: A contradiction manufactured out of two true answers.

aspect: The relationship is damaged by the process
description: Couples describe the interview as introducing a suspicion between them that was not there before, and the state has no mechanism that registers that as a cost.
energy_note: Made to doubt each other, by a procedure.
